record.question: Which of the following drug can cause brownish discolouration of deciduous teeth in children if given during pregnancy?
record.explanation: Answer D: Tetracycline. Tetracyclines can bind calcium in developing teeth and cause discoloration; use during pregnancy can affect fetal developing teeth/bone. Source/context note: Risk and recommendations depend on timing and agent; avoid class-wide assumptions for newer derivatives. Reference: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK549905/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
